18: "Such and such you shall return, etc." — see what the Sma wrote in se'if katan 19, where he wrote: "And also for kenas claims, migo is effective, as the Tur wrote later in siman 399, etc." And the Ramah whom the Tur brings later in siman 399 disagrees and holds that for kenas, migo is not effective. And so the Nimukei Yosef wrote at the end of Perek HaManiach. And what the Sma wrote — that the Mordechai wrote so [that migo works for kenas] at the end of Perek HaManiach — there is no proof from there. Because perhaps the Mordechai holds that the sugya goes according to the position that palga nizka mamona, as the Nimukei Yosef wrote there, and so [is written in] the Maggid Mishneh end of perek 9 of Hilchos Nizkei Mamon, see there, and analyze carefully. And see what I wrote later in siman 399 se'if 3.
